patches.title: MempoolAuditor: rebroadcast a pooled transaction together with its in-pool ancestors
patches.fixes: a transaction announced before its unconfirmed parent is declined by the receiving peer; after a rollback, a chain of wallet payments returns to the pool and the rebroadcast checks each announced window of 3 only against the state and itself, so a chained set reaches the next miner as a random walk. Since v6.0.8 (#2641 clears the declined table every block) it gets there in about 130-190 s, often after a test deadline; with the ancestors announced together it takes one round (26-112 s)
patches.witness: v2 (bounded iterative walk): unit MempoolAuditorSpec 4/4, change mutated out -> the 2 new tests fail; network reorg-mempool on v6.0.6 + v2: 10 of 10 in both valid runs (2 further runs inconclusive: no rebroadcast round, the payments absent from the sender pool after the rollback, independent of the patch). v1: 10 of 10 in 2 runs.; v6.0.8 hosted A/B (sweep runs 38853379783 release / 38853381827 reference, reorg-mempool + reorg-mempool-phases, 5 repeats each): release 8 of 10 PASS (2 FAIL: payments not re-confirmed by the deadline), reference 10 of 10
responses: 2026-10-14: the v6.0.7-closed PR was reopened by jozanek and retargeted to v6.0.9; head rebased onto v6.0.9 (production lines unchanged); patch re-exported 2026-10-15 for base v6.0.8
